name: an unreachable backend is an opaque 500 on the task list
description: The list endpoint fails the same way stats does when the backend is unreachable: a generic 500 ERR_INTERNAL that leaks nothing about the store. It has its own fixture because ListActive is a separate query from Stats, and a backend that answers one but not the other is a real state — so both are pinned to fail closed rather than leak.
